local_patches.reason: upstream stages Resources/JSBSim via a Windows path literal (@"Resources\JSBSim\*"), which matches nothing on macOS or Linux, so the runtime aircraft data is silently not staged

declares FGPropertyNode*, a type absent from JSBSim 1.2.4; FGPropertyManager::GetNode returns SGPropertyNode*. The plugin is written against an older JSBSim than the library in the same repository, and does not compile without this.
